title: Bent Pine Patrol

summary.short: Bin and Peri test the Bent Pine line before Haven can settle.
summary.default: The patrol reaches Watch Ridge and confirms the route is not safe yet.

syncSummary: Hub problem added: Something is stalking the patrol line up close.
Rumor added: the Bent Pine route now has a confirmed moving threat.

quest.title: Watch Ridge Cleanup

objectives.label: Report the patrol result at Frostbitten Gate

completionOps.text: Something keeps crossing the Bent Pine patrol line and forcing bad fights up close.

completionOps.title: Story Sync: Bent Pine Patrol
completionOps.summary: The Bent Pine route stays unstable after a live patrol check.

nodes.text: The gate still smells like wet wool and nerves when Peri drags Bin straight to the patrol board. Bent Pine is the shortest line to Watch Ridge, which is exactly why everyone stopped trusting it.

nodes.speaker: Peri
nodes.text: We sweep the line, check the ridge, and if something rushes us face-first we solve it immediately. No heroic paperwork, just movement and results.

ops.text: Story route: the patrol stays disciplined and visible.
Story route: Bin pushes the patrol into the trees for speed.

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: If the route is alive, we walk it before it learns our names.

nodes.speaker: Peri
nodes.text: That sounded reckless enough to count as confidence. Move.
Patrol Bent Pine, react to traps and roaming contact, and push through to Watch Ridge.

nodes.speaker: Peri
nodes.text: Watch Ridge is still standing, which is more than I promised. Now we tell the gate this line stays dangerous until someone clears it properly.

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: We got pushed off the line. Next pass needs fresh supplies, less pride, and maybe fewer things that sprint straight into your face.
The patrol breaks off before the ridge call is settled. Frostbitten will have questions waiting.
